title: How to Claim Google AI Pro Free for 12 Months Using Internshala
excerpt: Learn how to claim the Google AI Pro 12-month free trial through Internshala. Follow this step-by-step guide to check your eligibility and activate the offer.
content: Internshala is offering eligible students the opportunity to claim Google AI Pro for up to 12 months at no cost. If you meet the eligibility requirements, you can activate the offer by completing your profile and redeeming it through the official promotion page. This guide walks you through the complete process.
seo_title: How to Get Google AI Pro Free for 12 Months via Internshala
seo_description: Step-by-step guide to claim Google AI Pro free for 12 months through Internshala's student offer.
seo_keywords: google ai pro free, internshala google ai, google ai premium free, gemini advanced free, google student offer
author: Midhun NK

subtopics.title: 1. Open the Google AI Pro Offer Page
subtopics.details: Start by visiting the official Internshala Google AI Pro offer page. This page contains the eligibility requirements and the option to claim the promotional offer.

subtopics.title: 2. Sign In or Create an Internshala Account
subtopics.details: If you don't already have an Internshala account, create one using your email address or Google account. Existing users can simply sign in.
ordered_list: Click Sign In or Sign Up

subtopics.title: 3. Complete Your Profile
subtopics.details: Fill in your profile details, including your education information. Completing your profile is often required before the offer becomes available.

subtopics.title: 4. Verify Your Graduation Year
subtopics.details: The promotion may only be available for eligible graduation years. If the offer page specifies a qualifying graduation year, ensure your profile matches those requirements before continuing.

subtopics.title: 5. Claim the Google AI Pro Offer
subtopics.details: Return to the offer page and click the claim or start trial button. You will be redirected to the Google subscription page.

subtopics.title: 6. Verify the 12-Month Free Trial
subtopics.details: Before subscribing, confirm that the Google checkout page clearly shows a 12-month free trial. If it doesn't, do not continue until you verify the offer.

subtopics.title: 7. Add a Payment Method
subtopics.details: Google may require a valid payment method to verify your account before activating the trial. No charges should occur during the free trial period unless you continue after it ends.
unordered_list: Cancel before renewal if you don't want to continue
Keep track of the renewal date

subtopics.title: 8. Start Using Google AI Pro
subtopics.details: Once activated, you'll have access to Google AI Pro features included with your subscription. The exact features available may vary depending on your region and Google's current offering.
